VBO:0200803.summary: Affectionate and fond of offering a paw, two-year-old Alex gives a rescue’s account of the Labstaff, a Staffordshire Bull Terrier–Labrador cross. Rescue Remedies described him as calm and well-mannered indoors, a keen runner and a comfortable car traveller. Sudden movements or noises could still spook him.
VBO:0200803.shortDescription: Alex’s rescue account describes an affectionate Labstaff who offered a paw, settled indoors and travelled well by car.
